diagnosticQualifications: All recorded replays are read-only counterexamples, never production seeds or witnesses.
Prerequisite replay leaf callbacks deliberately return DEAD_END. Their leaf counts are not full planning leaves.
Selective replay stops locally after its first Hall; diagnostic BUDGET_EXHAUSTED is not a product outcome.

The technical replay first duplicated future joint members and was invalid. Its 351 apparent prunes are excluded. Correct projection removes the members before the authority appends them; corrected trials have zero prunes.
Certified learning reduced repeated closure calls in its own trial but charged canonical certification and produced zero prerequisite backjumps. No functional improvement.
Single tighter prerequisite moves the first conflict to entry 10103 / C08 closure 10104. All 64 subsets isolate four decisions, not a global infeasibility certificate.
